input: Draft a script for a short animated explainer

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Short Animated Explainer Script
gold.taskDescription: Write a script for a short animated explainer video on a topic yet to be defined.

questions.title: What specific topic or product does this explain?
questions.description: Identify the exact subject matter the explainer video will cover.

questions.title: Who is the intended audience for this video?
questions.description: Define the target viewers in terms of age, background, or expertise level.

questions.title: What is the desired length of the video?
questions.description: Determine the target runtime, such as 60, 90, or 120 seconds.

questions.title: What single action should viewers take after watching?
questions.description: Clarify the one call-to-action or key takeaway the video must drive.

questions.title: What tone should the script use throughout?
questions.description: Establish whether the voice should be playful, professional, inspirational, or another style.

questions.title: Is there an existing brand voice or style guide to follow?
questions.description: Check if there are brand guidelines, preferred vocabulary, or phrases to include or avoid.

questions.title: Where will this video be published or presented?
questions.description: Identify the distribution channel, such as a website, social media, or a live pitch deck.
